mn129:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn129:2.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bālāpadānāni.
mn129:2.3: idha bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca hoti dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkatakammakārī ca.
mn129:2.4: no cetaṃ bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca abhavissa dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkatakammakārī ca kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ:
mn129:2.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca hoti dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkatakammakārī ca, tasmā naṃ paṇḍitā jānanti:
mn129:3.1: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo tividhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:3.2: sace bhikkhave, bālo sabhāyaṃ vā nisinno hoti. rathiyāya vā nisinno hoti. siṅghāṭake vā nisinno hoti.
mn129:3.3: tatra ce jano tajjaṃ tassāruppaṃ kathaṃ manteti
mn129:3.4: sace bhikkhave, bālo pāṇātipātī hoti. adinnādāyī hoti. kāmesumicchācārī hoti. musāvādī hoti. surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
mn129:3.6: yaṃ kho jano tajjaṃ tassāruppaṃ kathaṃ manteti.
mn129:3.7: saṃvijjante te ca dhammā mayi, ahañca tesu dhammesu sandissāmīti.
mn129:3.8: idaṃ bhikkhave, bālo paṭhamaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bālo passati rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente:
mn129:4.2: kasāhipi tāḷente, vettehipi tāḷente, addhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷente, hatthampi chindante, pādampi chindante, hatthapādampi chindante, kaṇṇampi chindante, nāsampi chindante, kaṇṇanāsampi chindante, bilaṅgathālikampi karonte, saṅkhamuṇḍikampi karonte, rāhumukhampi karonte, jotimālikampi karonte, hatthapajjotikampi karonte, erakavattikampi karonte, cīrakavāsikampi karonte, eṇeyyakampi karonte, balisamaṃsikampi karonte, kahāpaṇakampi karonte, khārāpatacchikampi karonte, palighaparivattikampi karonte, palālapīṭhakampi karonte, tattenapi telena osiñcante, sunakhehipi khādāpente, jīvantampi sūle uttāsente, asināpi sīsaṃ chindante.
mn129:4.4: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kāronti:
mn129:4.5: kasāhipi tāḷenti vettehipi tāḷenti. addhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷenti. hatthampi chindanti. pādampi chindanti. hatthapādampi chindanti. kaṇṇampi chindanti. nāsampi chindanti. kaṇṇanāsampi chindanti. bilaṅgathālikampi karonti. saṅkhamuṇḍikampi karonti. rāhumukhampi karonti. jotimālikampi karonti. hatthapajjotikampi karonti. erakavattikampi karonti. cīrakavāsikampi karonti. eṇeyyakampi karonti. balisamaṃsikampi karonti. kahāpaṇakampi karonti. khārāpatacchikampi karonti. palighaparivattikampi karonti. palālapiṭṭhikampi karonti. tattenapi telena osiñcanti. sunakhehipi khādāpenti. jīvantampi sūle uttāsenti. asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti.
mn129:4.6: saṃvijjante te ca dhammā mayi, ahañca tesu dhammesu sandissāmi.
mn129:4.7: mañcepi rājāno ājāneyyuṃ mampi rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kāreyyuṃ:
mn129:4.8: kasāhipi tāḷeyyuṃ. vettehipi tāḷeyyuṃ. addhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷeyyuṃ. hatthampi chindeyyuṃ. pādampi chindeyyuṃ. hatthapādampi chindeyyuṃ. kaṇṇampi chindeyyuṃ. nāsampi chindeyyuṃ. kaṇṇanāsampi chindeyyuṃ. bilaṅgathālikampi kareyyuṃ. saṅkhamuṇḍikampi kareyyuṃ. rāhumukhampi kareyyuṃ. jotimālikampi kareyyuṃ. hatthapajjotikampi kareyyuṃ. erakavattikampi kareyyuṃ. cīrakavāsikampi kareyyuṃ. eṇeyyakampi kareyyuṃ. balisamaṃsikampi kareyyuṃ. kahāpaṇakampi kareyyuṃ. khārāpatacchikampi kareyyuṃ. palighaparivattikampi kareyyuṃ. tattenapi telena osiñceyyuṃ. sunakhehipi khādāpeyyuṃ. jīvantampi sūle uttāseyyuṃ. asināpi sīsaṃ chindeyyunti.
mn129:4.9: idampi bhikkhave bālo dutiyaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bālaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyavā semānaṃ, yānissa pubbe pāpakāni kammāni katāni kāyena duccaritāni vācāya duccaritāni manasā duccaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti, ajjholambanti, abhippalambanti.
mn129:5.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mahantānaṃ pabbatakūṭānaṃ chāyā sāyanhasamayaṃ pathaviyā olambanti, ajjholambanti, abhippalambanti.
mn129:5.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, bālaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāya vā semānaṃ, yānissa pubbe pāpakāni kammāni katāni kāyena duccaritāni vācāya duccaritāni manasā duccaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti, ajjholambanti, abhippalambanti,
mn129:5.5: ‘akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ, akataṃ kusalaṃ, akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ.
mn129:5.6: kataṃ pāpaṃ, kataṃ luddakaṃ, kataṃ kibbisaṃ.
mn129:5.7: yā ca hoti akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati. taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī’ti.
mn129:5.8: so socati, kilamati, paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn129:5.9: idampi kho bhikkhave, bālo tatiyaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:6.1: sa kho so bhikkhave bālo kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:7.1: yaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn129:7.2: ‘ekantaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ ekantaṃ akantaṃ ekantaṃ amanāpa’nti. nirayamevetaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn129:7.3: ekantaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ ekantaṃ akantaṃ ekantaṃ amanāpanti.
mn129:7.4: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, upamāpi na sukarā yāva dukkhā nirayāti.
mn129:7.5: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn129:7.6: sakkā pana me bhante, upamaṃ kātunti?
mn129:8.2: ‘seyyathāpi bhikkhu, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ:
mn129:8.3: ‘ayaṃ kho deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi, taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī’ti.
mn129:8.5: ‘gacchatha bho, imaṃ purisaṃ pubbaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathā’ti.
mn129:8.11: ‘gacchatha, bho, taṃ purisaṃ majjhantikasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathā’ti.
mn129:8.17: ‘gacchatha, bho, taṃ purisaṃ sāyanhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathā’ti.
mn129:8.20: api nu so puriso tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethā’ti?
mn129:8.21: ekissāpi bhante, sattiyā haññamāno so puriso tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha. ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehīti.
mn129:9.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ pāṇimattaṃ pāsāṇaṃ gahetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn129:9.3: katamo nu kho mahantataro, yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito, yo ca himavā pabbatarājā’ti?
mn129:9.4: appamatto kho ayaṃ bhante, bhagavatā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito, himavantaṃ pabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upetī’ti.
mn129:9.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, yaṃ so puriso tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. taṃ nerayikassa dukkhassa upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti. kalabhāgampi na upeti. upanidhimpi na upeti.
mn129:10.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ karonti:
mn129:10.2: tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ hatthe gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiye hatthe gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ pāde gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiye pāde gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti.
mn129:10.3: so tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti. na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti, yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:11.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā saṃvesetvā kuṭhārīhi tacchanti.
mn129:11.2: so tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti. na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti, yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:12.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhapādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā vāsīhi tacchanti.
mn129:12.2: so tattha …pe… yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:13.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya paṭhaviyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya sārentipi paccāsārentipi.
mn129:13.2: so tattha …pe… yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:14.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā mahantaṃ aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āropentipi oropentipi.
mn129:14.2: so tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti. na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti. yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:15.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhapādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya.
mn129:15.3: so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gacchati. sakimpi adho gacchati. sakimpi tiriyaṃ gacchati.
mn129:15.4: so tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti. na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantīhoti.
mn129:17.1: anekapariyāyenapi kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, nirayakathaṃ katheyyaṃ,
mn129:17.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, na sukarāṃ akkhānena pāpuṇituṃ yāva dukkhā nirayāti.
mn129:18.2: te allānipi tiṇāni sukkhānipi tiṇāni dantullehakaṃ khādanti.
mn129:18.3: katame ca bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā tiṇabhakkhā,
mn129:18.4: assā goṇā gadrabhā ajā migā, ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā tiṇabhakkhā.
mn129:18.5: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo idha pubbe rasādo idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati ye te sattā tiṇabhakkhā.
mn129:19.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, santi tiracchānagatā pāṇā gūthabhakkhā,
mn129:19.9: katame ca bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā gūthabhakkhā:
mn129:19.10: kukkuṭā sūkarā soṇā sigālā, ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā gūthabhakkhā.
mn129:19.11: sa kho so bhikkhave bālo idha pubbe rasādo idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati ye te sattā gūthabhakkhā.
mn129:20.1: santi bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā andhakāre jāyanti andhakāre jīyanti andhakāre mīyanti.
mn129:20.2: katame ca bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā andhakāre jāyanti andhakāre jīyanti andhakāre mīyanti:
mn129:20.3: kīṭā pulavā gaṇḍuppādā, ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā andhakāre jāyanti andhakāre jīyanti andhakāre mīyanti.
mn129:20.4: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo pubbe rasādo, idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati, ye te sattā andhakāre jāyanti andhakāre jīyanti andhakāre mīyanti.
mn129:21.1: santi bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā udakasmiṃ jāyanti udakasmiṃ jīyanti udakasmiṃ mīyanti.
mn129:21.2: katame ca bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā udakasmiṃ jāyanti udakasmiṃ jīyanti udakasmiṃ mīyanti:
mn129:21.3: macchā kacchapā suṃsumārā ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā udakasmiṃ jāyanti udakasmiṃ jīyanti udakasmiṃ mīyanti.
mn129:21.4: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo idha pubbe rasādo idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati, ye te sattā udakasmiṃ jāyanti udakasmiṃ jīyanti udakasmiṃ mīyanti.
mn129:22.1: santi bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā asucismiṃ jāyanti asucismiṃ jīyanti asucismiṃ mīyanti.
mn129:22.2: katame ca bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā asucismiṃ jāyanti asucismiṃ jīyanti asucismiṃ mīyanti:
mn129:22.3: ye te bhikkhave, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtimacche vā jīyanti pūtimacche vā mīyanti. pūtikuṇape vā …pe…
mn129:22.7: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo idha pubbe rasādo idha pāpāni kammāni karitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tesaṃ sattānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati ye te sattā asucismiṃ jāyanti asucismiṃ jīyanti asucismiṃ mīyanti.
mn129:23.1: anekapariyāyenapi kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, tiracchānayonikathaṃ katheyyaṃ,
mn129:23.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, na sukaraṃ akkhānena pāpuṇituṃ yāva dukkhā tiracchānayonīti.
mn129:24.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso ekacchiggalaṃ yugaṃ mahāsamudde pakkhipeyya,
mn129:24.2: tamenaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya. pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya. uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya. dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
mn129:24.3: tatrāssa kāṇakacchapo, so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ ummujjeyya.
mn129:24.5: api nu so kāṇo kacchapo amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyāti?
mn129:24.7: yadi nu na bhante, kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayenāti.
mn129:24.8: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhave, kāṇo kacchapo amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyya, ato dullabhatarāhaṃ bhikkhave, manussattaṃ vadāmi sakiṃ vinipātagatena bālena.
mn129:24.10: na hettha bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā samacariyā kusalakiriyā puññakiriyā,
mn129:25.1: sa kho so bhikkhave, bālo sace kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena manussattaṃ āgacchati. yāni tāni nīcakulāni:
mn129:25.2: caṇḍālakulaṃ vā nesādakulaṃ vā veṇakulaṃ vā rathakārakulaṃ vā pukkusakulaṃ vā.
mn129:25.3: tathārūpe kule paccājāyati daḷidde appannapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
mn129:25.4: so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavhābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khujjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
mn129:25.5: so kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
mn129:25.6: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:26.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaliggahena puttampi jīyetha dārampi jīyetha sabbaṃ sāpateyyampi jīyetha uttarimpi anubandhaṃ nigaccheyya.
mn129:26.2: appamattako so bhikkhave, kaliggaho yaṃ so akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaliggahena puttampi jīyetha dārampi jīyetha sabbaṃ sāpateyyampi jīyetha uttarimpi anubandhaṃ nigaccheyya.
mn129:26.3: atha kho ayameva tato mahantataro kaliggaho: yaṃ so bālo kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:27.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍitāpadānāni.
mn129:27.3: idha bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca.
mn129:27.4: no ce taṃ bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca abhavissa subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca. kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ
mn129:28.1: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca tasmā naṃ paṇḍitā jānanti
mn129:28.3: sa kho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito tividhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:28.4: sace bhikkhave, paṇḍito sabhāya vā nisinno hoti, rathiyāya vā nisinno hoti. siṅghāṭake vā nisinno hoti.
mn129:28.5: tatra ce jano tajjaṃ tassāruppaṃ kathaṃ manteti.
mn129:28.6: sace bhikkhave, paṇḍito pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
mn129:28.8: yaṃ kho jano tajjaṃ tassāruppaṃ kathaṃ manteti.
mn129:28.9: saṃvijjanteva te dhammā mayi, ahañca tesu dhammesu sandissāmī’ti.
mn129:28.10: idaṃ bhikkhave, paṇḍito paṭhamaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:29.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, paṇḍito passati rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente.
mn129:29.2: kasāhipi tāḷente vettehipi tāḷente …pe… asināpi sīsaṃ chindante.
mn129:29.4: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti kasāhipi tāḷenti. vettehipi tāḷenti …pe… asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti, na te dhammā mayi saṃvijjanti, ahañca na tesu dhammesu sandissāmīti.
mn129:29.5: idampi bhikkhave, paṇḍito dutiyaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:30.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, paṇḍitaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāya vā semānaṃ. yānissa pubbe kalyāṇāni kammāni katāni kāyena sucaritāni vācāya sucaritāni manasā sucaritāni tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
mn129:30.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mahantānaṃ pabbatakūṭānaṃ chāyā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭhaviyā olambanti, ajjholambanti, abhippalambanti.
mn129:30.3: eva meva kho bhikkhave, paṇḍitaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāya vā semānaṃ yānissa pubbe kalyāṇāni kammāni katāni kāyena sucaritāni vācāya sucaritāni manasā sucaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti, ajjholambanti, abhippalambanti.
mn129:30.5: ‘akataṃ vata me pāpaṃ akataṃ luddaṃ akataṃ kibbisaṃ,
mn129:30.6: kataṃ kalyāṇaṃ kataṃ kusalaṃ kataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ.
mn129:30.7: yāvatā hoti akatapāpānaṃ akataluddānaṃ akatakibbisānaṃ, katakalyāṇānaṃ katakusalānaṃ katabhīruttāṇānaṃ gati, taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī’ti.
mn129:30.8: so na socati, na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn129:30.9: idampi bhikkhave, paṇḍito tatiyaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:31.1: sa kho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:32.1: yaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn129:32.2: ‘ekantaṃ iṭṭhaṃ ekantaṃ kantaṃ ekantaṃ manāpa’nti. saggameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn129:32.4: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, upamāpi na sukarā yāvasukhā saggāti.
mn129:32.5: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn129:33.2: “seyyathāpi bhikkhu, rājā cakkavattī sattahi ratanehi samannāgato catūhi ca iddhīhi, tato nidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:34.2: idha bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
mn129:34.3: taṃ disvāna rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa evaṃ hoti:
mn129:34.4: ‘sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ: yassa rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ, so hoti rājā cakkavattī.
mn129:34.5: assaṃ nu kho ahaṃ rājā cakkavattī’ti.
mn129:35.1: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto uṭṭhāyāsanā vāmena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkirati,
mn129:35.3: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave, cakkaratanaṃ puratthimaṃ disaṃ pavattati, anvadeva rājā cakkavattī saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya. yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, padese cakkaratanaṃ patiṭṭhāti. tatra rājā cakkavattī vāsaṃ upeti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
mn129:35.4: ye kho pana bhikkhave, puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu:
mn129:35.5: ‘ehi kho mahārāja, svāgataṃ mahārāja, sakante mahārāja, anusāsa mahārājā’ti.
mn129:35.7: ‘pāṇo na hantabbo, adinnaṃ nādātabbaṃ, kāmesu micchā na caritabbā, musā na bhāsitabbā, majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ, yathābhuttañca bhuñjathā’ti.
mn129:35.8: ye kho pana bhikkhave, puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā bhavanti.
mn129:35.9: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakkaratanaṃ puratthimasamuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pavattati …pe…
mn129:35.10: dakkhiṇaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā pacchimaṃ disaṃ pavattati …pe…
mn129:35.11: pacchimaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā uttaraṃ disaṃ pavattati. anvadeva rājā cakkavattī saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya. yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, padese cakkaratanaṃ patiṭṭhāti. tattha rājā cakkavattī vāsaṃ upeti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
mn129:35.12: ye kho pana bhikkhave, uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu:
mn129:35.13: ‘ehi kho mahārāja, svāgataṃ mahārāja, sakaṃ te mahārāja, anusāsa mahārājā’ti.
mn129:35.15: ‘pāṇo na hantabbo, adinnaṃ nādātabbaṃ, kāmesu micchā na caritabbā, musā na bhāsitabbā, majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ, yathābhuttañca bhuñjathā’ti.
mn129:35.16: ye kho pana bhikkhave, uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā bhavanti.
mn129:35.17: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave, cakkaratanaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ abhivijinitvā tameva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño cakkavattissa ante puradvāre akkhāhataṃ maññe tiṭṭhati, rañño cakkavattissa antepuradvāraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ.
mn129:35.18: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:36.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa hatthiratanaṃ pātubhavati
mn129:36.2: sabbaseto sattappatiṭṭho iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo uposatho nāgarājā.
mn129:36.3: taṃ disvāna rañño cakkavattissa cittaṃ pasīdati.
mn129:36.4: bhaddakaṃ vata bho hatthiyānaṃ, sace damathaṃ upeyyā’ti.
mn129:36.5: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave, hatthiratanaṃ seyyathāpi nāma bhaddo hatthājānīyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto, evameva damathaṃ upeti.
mn129:36.6: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī tameva hatthiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ abhiruhitvā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ anusaṃyāyitvā tameva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā pātarāsaṃ akāsi.
mn129:36.7: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ hatthiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:37.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa assaratanaṃ pātubhavati
mn129:37.2: sabbaseto kākasīso muñjakeso iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo valāhako assarājā.
mn129:37.4: bhaddakaṃ vata bho assayānaṃ, sace damathaṃ upeyyā’ti.
mn129:37.5: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave, assaratanaṃ seyyathāpi nāma bhaddo assājānīyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto, evameva damathaṃ upeti.
mn129:37.6: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī tameva assaratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno pubbanhasamayaṃ abhiruhitvā samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ anusaṃyāyitvā tameva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā pātarāsaṃ akāsi.
mn129:37.7: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ assaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:38.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa maṇiratanaṃ pātubhavati
mn129:38.2: so hoti maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato
mn129:38.3: tassa kho pana bhikkhave, maṇiratanassa ābhā samantā yojanaṃ phuṭā hoti.
mn129:38.4: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī tameva maṇiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā maṇiṃ dhajaggaṃ āropetvā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ pāyāsi.
mn129:38.5: ye kho pana bhikkhave, samantā gāmā ahesuṃ, te tenobhāsena kammante payojesuṃ divāti maññamānā.
mn129:38.6: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ maṇiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:39.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa itthiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:39.2: abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā nātidīghā nātirassā nātikisā nātithūlā nātikāḷī nāccodātā, atikkantā mānusaṃ vaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbaṃ vaṇṇaṃ.
mn129:39.3: tassa kho pana bhikkhave, itthiratanassa evarūpo kāyasamphasso hoti: seyyathāpi nāma tūlapicuno vā kappāsapicuno vā
mn129:39.4: tassa kho pana bhikkhave, itthiratanassa sīte uṇhāni gattāni honti. uṇhe sītāni gattāni honti.
mn129:39.5: tassa kho pana bhikkhave, itthiratanassa kāyato candanagandho vāyati. mukhato uppalagandho vāyati.
mn129:39.6: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave, itthiratanaṃ rañño cakkavattissa pubbuṭṭhāyinī hoti pacchānipātinī kiṃkārapaṭissāvinī manāpacārinī piyavādinī.
mn129:39.7: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave, itthiratanaṃ rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ manasāpi no aticarati, kuto pana kāyena.
mn129:39.8: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ itthiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:40.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa gahapatiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:40.2: tassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ pātubhavati, yena nidhiṃ passati sassāmikampi assāmikampi.
mn129:40.4: appossukko tvaṃ deva hohi. ahaṃ te dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ karissāmī’ti.
mn129:40.5: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī tameva gahapatiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno nāvaṃ abhiruhitvā majjhegaṅgāya nadiyā sotaṃ ogahetvā gahapatiratanaṃ etadavoca:
mn129:40.7: tena hi mahārāja ekaṃ tīraṃ nāvā upetū’ti.
mn129:40.9: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave, gahapatiratanaṃ ubhohi hatthehi udake omasitvā pūraṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa kumbhiṃ uddharitvā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ evamāha:
mn129:40.10: alaṃ ettāvatā mahārāja, kataṃ ettāvatā mahārāja, pūjitaṃ ettāvatā mahārājā’ti.
mn129:40.12: alaṃ ettāvatā gahapati, kataṃ ettāvatā gahapati, pūjitaṃ ettāvatā gahapatī’ti.
mn129:40.13: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa parināyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.2: paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ apayāpetabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ. ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ.
mn129:41.4: appossukko tvaṃ deva hohi. ahaṃ anusāsissāmī’ti.
mn129:41.5: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ parināyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.6: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imehi sattahi ratanehi samannāgato hoti.
mn129:42.2: idha bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:42.3: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imāya paṭhamāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:43.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī dīghāyuko hoti ciraṭṭhitiko ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:43.2: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imāya dutiyāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:44.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:44.2: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imāya tatiyāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:45.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo.
mn129:45.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, pitā puttānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo,
mn129:45.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī, brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo.
mn129:45.4: raññopi bhikkhave, cakkavattissa brāhmaṇagahapatikā piyā honti manāpā.
mn129:45.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, pitu puttā piyā honti manāpā.
mn129:45.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, raññopi cakkavattissa brāhmaṇagahapatikā piyā honti manāpā.
mn129:45.7: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī caturaṅginiyā senāya uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyāsi.
mn129:45.8: atha kho bhikkhave, brāhmaṇagahapatikā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu:
mn129:45.9: ‘ataramāno, deva, yāhi, yathā taṃ mayaṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmā’ti.
mn129:45.11: ‘ataramāno sārathi, pesehi yathā maṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikā cirataraṃ passeyya’nti.
mn129:45.12: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imāya catutthāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:45.13: rājā bhikkhave, cakkavattī imāhi catūhi iddhīhi samannāgato hoti.
mn129:46.2: api nu kho rājā cakkavattī imehi sattahi ratanehi samannāgato imāhi catūhi ca iddhīhi tato nidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethāti.
mn129:46.3: ekamekenāpi bhante, ratanena samannāgato rājā cakkavattī tato nidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha. ko pana vādo sattahi ratanehi catūhi ca iddhīhīti.
mn129:47.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ pāṇimattaṃ pāsāṇaṃ gahetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn129:47.3: katamo nu kho mahantataro: yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito, yo ca himavā pabbatarājāti.
mn129:47.4: appamattako ayaṃ bhante, bhagavatā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito himavantaṃ pabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti.
mn129:47.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, yaṃ rājā cakkavattī sattahi ratanehi catūhi ca iddhīhi samannāgato tato nidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. taṃ dibbassa sukhassa upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti.
mn129:48.1: sa kho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito sace kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena manussattaṃ āgacchati. yāni tāni uccākulāni
mn129:48.2: khattiyamahāsālakulaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakulaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālakulaṃ vā, tathārūpe kule paccājāyati aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavittūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe.
mn129:48.3: so ca hoti abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato. lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
mn129:48.4: so kāyena sucaritaṃ carati, vācāya sucaritaṃ carati, manasā sucaritaṃ carati.
mn129:48.5: so kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:49.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaṭaggahena mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigaccheyya,
mn129:49.2: appamattako so bhikkhave, kaṭaggaho, yaṃ so akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaṭaggahena mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigaccheyya.
mn129:49.3: atha kho ayameva tato mahantataro kaṭaggaho, yaṃ so paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:49.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
